proposition: Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i ʿAmāʾ existed by 3 Dhū l-Ḥijja 827 (27 October 1424); Melvin-Koushki flags the date as possibly transcription, so it is a terminus ad quem, not a composition date. It is the earliest-dated of the works in MS Majlis 10196 that fall in this range.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
